_comment: Shared conformance vectors for THE SCREEN READ — how many independent directions a frame has. There are two implementations of this one question and they cannot import each other: beam/optics.py (full aperture) and mantle/search/beacon (reduced, dependency-free, shipped to corporate installs). Same idiom as contract_vectors.json, which pins prism-py/js/c parity. Each case REGENERATES its frame from (seed,N,F,planted,snr) with numpy default_rng, so no matrix is stored and both sides build byte-identical input. A change to either engine that moves a number here is a DELIBERATE act and must move this file in the same commit.
_how_to_build: rng=numpy.random.default_rng(seed); M=rng.normal(size=(N,F)); then `planted` times: u=rng.normal(N); v=rng.normal(F); M += snr*outer(u/|u|, v/|v|). If collapse: M is all zeros with column 0 = rng.normal(N). Finally, if dead_cols > 0, zero the LAST dead_cols columns — drawn first and killed after, so the live part of the frame is byte-identical to the same case with dead_cols absent.
_known_divergence: SIX divergences, all DELIBERATE, all pinned so neither engine is 'fixed' to match the other by accident. (1) `noise_only`: beacon reports k=1, beam reports k_signal=0 — beacon.resolved_rank floors at 1 because returning 0 would make every downstream projection empty rather than coarse. (2) `collapsed_axis`: beacon reports live_channels=1/degraded=true, beam reports scale_hazard=false — see _hazard. (3) [2026-08-04, D6] beacon's `coherence` is ALWAYS None. It is the ordered-axis lag-1 z-score, and a SET of vectors has no lag-1 pair; None means NOT MEASURED and must never be read as 0.0. This is the same fact as beacon filling zero `Dynamics` members. (4) [2026-08-04, D6] the CERTIFIED INTERVAL MODELS A DIFFERENT ERROR IN EACH ENGINE, so the two `k_certain` flags do not mean the same thing and must NOT be reconciled: beam's is a Weyl band on ||C_read - C_true||_2, the covariance ESTIMATION error, while beacon's corpus IS the population so no estimation error exists to bound — beacon's interval is the sampling scatter of the noise edge itself, q(far) vs q(1-far), which is why k_lo == k_signal there by construction. (5) [2026-08-04, D6] MIN_ROWS is 2 for beacon and 4 for beam: beam's comes from the falling factorial of its lag-1 permutation variance, and beacon has no lag term, so its boundary is min(N, F_live) >= 2 — recovered from the gate, never typed. (6) [2026-08-05] beacon fills ZERO `prism.instrument.Instrument` members and beam fills all three (`absorb_transmit`, `next_by_coupling`, `membrane_screen`), so `isinstance(beacon, Instrument)` is False and `isinstance(beam.optics, Instrument)` is True. ⛔ THIS IS THE ONLY DIVERGENCE ON THIS LIST THAT IS NOT A FACT ABOUT VECTORS, AND IT MUST NOT BE 'FIXED' BY GROWING BEACON — beacon COULD implement all three (D6 did, on 2026-08-04, from a rank plus an SVD basis; they were removed on 2026-08-05). It is a fact about the PRODUCT LINE. mantle ships Apache-2.0 so a store can be taken, built on and shipped by anyone; the entroptics wrapper is AGPL and is the product. [John, 2026-08-05: "'Reduced' in beacon just means it does the CUT ONLY. It's the silhouette. Still PERFECT. But the projection and prediction flows are in the Aperture. That's the real product."] ⭐ WHY A SCEPTICAL READER SHOULD BELIEVE THE GIVEAWAY IS HONEST RATHER THAN CRIPPLED, WHICH IS WHAT THIS FILE IS EVIDENCE FOR: the seam is drawn at a real joint, not at an arbitrary feature line. THE CUT — how many independent directions a set has, which of them are signal, where the set stops, whether an item is off the coherent subspace — is COMPLETE in beacon and is what the vectors above pin. `mantle.search.beacon.cut` (Apache, public, 2026-08-05) holds the whole of the RAG-facing screen math and is held BIT-EQUAL to the implementation it came from over 13,922 comparisons across 13 functions, zero disagreements. What beacon does not do is PROJECTION (carry a signal through a membrane and account for what arrived) and PREDICTION (`Dynamics`, divergence 3 — and that one beacon genuinely cannot do, because a set has no lag). Nothing in the cut is degraded, sampled, rate-limited or held back; the reduced instrument answers the question it answers exactly as the aperture does, which is why the parity vectors above exist at all. ⚠ CONSEQUENCE FOR A HOST, STATED: `prism.instrument.require(beacon, 'absorb_transmit', contract='embodiment', at=...)` raises `InstrumentRequired` (503) naming the member and the contract — a partial embodiment doing what it can and refusing exactly what it cannot, never `None` and never a fabricated split. A beacon-backed crystal reads and cannot condense; that is a real deployment, not a degenerate one.
_hazard: `collapsed_axis` is where the two engines DIVERGE, and the pins record it: beacon reports live_channels=1 and degraded=true; beam reports scale_hazard=false. BOTH ARE CORRECT — this is the embodiment split, not a gap. beacon's domain is the CORPUS, a set of vectors where a dead channel is anomalous. beam's aperture reads the SIGNAL, where sparse ontology coordinates make zero-MAD channels the NORMAL case: measured 2026-08-04, a frame at 2%, 5% or even 20% density has zero-MAD in ALL 64 channels, so a live-channel trigger in beam would be permanently true — the same defect as a dead one, wearing the opposite sign. beam's two triggers are both MEASUREMENTS rather than levels (a non-finite coherence z; f_eff <= 1), and it still reports top_share=1.0 and k_signal=0 on this frame, so the READING is honest and only the FLAG is absent. A proposal to add a third trigger was raised and REVERSED on this measurement.
_dead_channels: `dead_channels` is a storage-layout case, not a signal case: it is a frame MEASURED at 10 channels and STORED at 16. A dead channel is the absence of a measurement, not a measurement of zero, so both engines must restrict to the live view before decomposing and return the same read they return for the tight 120x10 frame. The pin is therefore an INVARIANCE as much as a number: `beacon.occupancy` here is the occupancy of the tight frame, to 17 significant digits. Counting the dead columns in the denominator instead reads 0.255912 — the same frame 1.600x more coherent purely because of how it was laid out — which is what this case exists to refuse.
